name: Generic Process Profiles register (ISO 19135:2026)
abstract: This register described with the Registered Item Model (ISO 19135:2026): one rim:Register, three rim:RegisterItemClasses (Process Concept, Generic Profile, Implementation Profile) and the three owl:Classes, each a sub-class of rim:RegisterItem, that every entry of the corresponding tier is typed with. A profile of ogc.rim.schemas.register-item-class, following the same pattern as that register's own activity-type profile.

sources.title: ISO 19135:2026, Geographic information — Registration and register governance
OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 Interface Standard Corrigendum 2, §7.5 Process profiles
